title: agent-frontends.md §7 numbering: no item 8, and the rendered numbers drift
description:
Found during the prose pass over the docs.

docs/design/agent-frontends.md §7 has no item 8: the list runs 1 to 7 and then jumps to 9. Item 7's title, "A ChatContact or Chat that is gone", looks like items 7 and 8 merged by commit 394d7123. `§7.8` is still cited three times, from §3 steps 3, 4 and 5.

The consequence is worse than a gap. CommonMark takes only the first number of an ordered list and renders the rest in sequence, so from item 9 on every rendered number is one lower than the `§7.N` it is cited as: what renders as "8." is cited as §7.9, and what renders as "29." is cited as §7.30. A reader who counts the rendered list and a reader who greps the source land on different items.

The source numbers are the ones the citations match: 146 `agent-frontends.md §N` references in source comments and docs, 32 in the beads, and 33 beads point into the file. So renumbering is not the fix. Two candidates:

- restore an explicit item 8, either the content that was merged into 7 or a placeholder saying where it went, so source and rendered numbering line up again;
- turn §7's items into headings, which do not renumber, at the cost of changing every heading line in that section.

Either is a content decision, not a prose fix, so the pass left it.
close_reason: Item 8 restored as the citation target its three references expect; source and rendered numbering match again. Commit a1a26cdb.
